## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      3 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jul 15, 2026 - Aug 5, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Niayesh Rezai_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "The free message system has become extremely frustrating. My counter has been stuck at 0 for over a week and never resets. I haven't even used the app during that time. The app keeps telling me to subscribe, but gives no explanation about why the limit won't reset. Many users seem to be experiencing the same issue. Chai was much better before these changes. If the free tier is no longer supported, just be honest about it instead of leaving users locked out with no information."
            2. _Doll Possessed_, Aug 4, 2026, 1/5: "🙂💔 this app has broken my heart really bad .. i was addicted to it alot and all of a sudden it blocked me and now I can't move on .. bruh I mean 🙂this app is losing users if developers are not removing this regional block thing . i mean ... we were never bothered with the ads too and watched every ad.."
            3. _April H_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "as long as you can afford the subscription the app is good. if you can't then the ads get aggravating especially being at the top of chat. it makes it to where you can not see what you type after a few lines. here lately, I can chat for a few paragraphs then it stop responding. have to close app and restart it. a few more paragraphs then it quits responding. have to close and restart again. very annoying. if they would get rid of ads at the top of messages then it would be ok. need to fix bugs."
